status_legend.yes: Official club page explicitly says a foreigner without a PESEL can buy ONLINE using a passport/ID number.
status_legend.accepted: Official sales rules accept a passport/ID number instead of PESEL, but do not explicitly say this works in the online shop. Expect it to work; box office is the fallback.
status_legend.unclear: Official rules ask for a PESEL and do not clearly cover short-stay visitors. Contact the club or buy at the box office.
status_legend.unverified: We have not found an official statement yet.

clubs.name: Legia Warszawa
clubs.evidence: FAQ: 'I am a foreigner without a PESEL – can I buy online? Yes … after creating a fan account (konto kibica) or via another person who has one.' A Fan Card (Karta Kibica) is not required.

avoid.text: South stand 'Żyleta' is the ultras' stand – expect to stand and chant all match; neutrals are advised to sit elsewhere. Big games (e.g. vs Lech) sell out fast.

clubs.name: Lech Poznań
clubs.evidence: FAQ: foreigners enter a passport or other ID number in the 'PESEL/other number' field when registering; also works when buying without logging in. Buying without a Fan Card is possible at the ticket point/stadium box office.

clubs.name: Widzew Łódź
clubs.evidence: 'How to buy a ticket' page: 'Can a person without a PESEL attend? Yes – during the ticket purchase you can choose a passport number instead of PESEL.'

clubs.name: Motor Lublin
clubs.evidence: Ticket sales regulations §: 'People without a PESEL can buy a ticket at club box offices, authorised points and via the online sales system, entering a passport number or other valid ID instead of PESEL.'

clubs.name: Zagłębie Lubin
clubs.evidence: 2026/27 sales regulations: for people without Polish citizenship and PESEL, the series/number of an ID document (e.g. passport) and date of birth are required. Online channel not spelled out.

clubs.name: Wisła Kraków
clubs.evidence: FAQ: 'I am a foreigner without a PESEL – how can I buy a ticket?' Enter a passport or other valid ID number in the 'PESEL/other number' field when creating an account; also possible when buying without logging in.

clubs.name: Raków Częstochowa
clubs.evidence: 2026/27 sales regulations require name + PESEL and showing ID; the ID list mentions passports/residence documents only for foreigners with longer-than-tourist stay permits. FAQ also says PESEL is required. Short-stay visitors: contact the club.

clubs.name: Korona Kielce
clubs.evidence: Sales regulations 2026/27, pt 9: 'To buy tickets in the System for people without Polish citizenship and PESEL, the series and number of an ID document (e.g. passport) and date of birth are required.' (The 'System' is the online ticket system.)

clubs.name: GKS Katowice
clubs.evidence: FAQ: 'How to buy tickets for foreigners? A foreigner must have a valid ID … for foreigners an ID document number plus date of birth is needed instead of PESEL.' Channel not spelled out.

clubs.name: Radomiak Radom
clubs.evidence: Sales regulations §2.3: buyer gives name, surname, PESEL, 'or, if none was issued, the type, series and number of an ID document'. Online channel not spelled out.

price.text: Single tickets 2026/27: 35–65 zł standard (25–55 zł concession); +10 zł for Premium games (Lech, Legia, Widzew); +5 zł on matchday; VIP Gold 300 zł.

clubs.name: Piast Gliwice
clubs.evidence: FAQ: 'Can a person without a PESEL attend? Yes – during the ticket purchase you can choose a passport number instead of PESEL.'

clubs.name: Cracovia
clubs.evidence: Ticket regulations §4.1 (online sales): register an account; up to 6 tickets per match giving name and PESEL '(for foreigners, another identity document)'. Season tickets need a Fan Card.

clubs.name: Jagiellonia Białystok
clubs.evidence: Only the 2025 SEASON-TICKET regulations were found: foreigners give type, series and number of their ID document instead of PESEL when registering in the online sales system. Single-ticket rules not yet checked.

clubs.name: Wisła Płock
clubs.evidence: FAQ: 'How to buy a ticket for a foreigner?' After choosing a seat, enter the document number, click FILL IN USER DATA, enter name and tick the FOREIGNER checkbox. Account registration also accepts an ID number.

clubs.name: Śląsk Wrocław
clubs.evidence: English FAQ: 'I am a foreign national and do not have a PESEL number – how can I buy a ticket? … enter your passport number or another valid identity document number … When purchasing without logging in, you can also enter your identification number.'

clubs.name: Górnik Zabrze
clubs.evidence: FAQ: people without a PESEL register with the ID they have: enter the document number in the PESEL field, click FILL IN DATA, tick 'Foreigner'. A Fan Card is not required.

clubs.name: Pogoń Szczecin
clubs.evidence: Q&A: 'Can I buy a ticket for a foreigner (no PESEL)? Yes – enter the ID card/passport number in the PESEL field and tick the foreigner option.' Matchday sales open ~10–18 days before each match.

clubs.name: Wieczysta Kraków
clubs.evidence: Sales regulations: if the ticket holder has no PESEL, the type, series and number of an ID document (passport, ID card, residence document) is given. Online channel not spelled out. Home games are at the Reymana stadium (shared with Wisła Kraków).

price.text: 2026/27: 25 zł standard, 10 zł concession (35/20 zł for selected big games); only sector E (~8,900 seats) + VIP open. Single-ticket sales open 14 days before each match.
